name: qlrisk_price_variance_swap
title: Price a VarianceSwap
description:
Price one Variance Swap (qlrisk VarianceSwap).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, notional=1000000, ticker=SPX, vega_notional, strike_vol_pct, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date, position.
Example: {"maturity": "1Y", "notional": 1000000} gives NPV 0.00 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
